resources.name: ui-designer
resources.title: UI Designer Agent
resources.description: An agent definition that composes, audits and repairs interfaces using a design system's DNA and the registry, with explicit refusal conditions for generic output.

resources.name: anti-slop
resources.title: Anti-Slop Rules
resources.description: The negative ruleset: the eleven failure modes that make generated interfaces recognisable, stated as prohibitions an agent can check against before it ships a layout.

resources.name: editorial-rules
resources.title: Editorial Rules
resources.description: The positive ruleset for editorial interfaces: how to compose with typography, ratio, hairlines and one accent, expressed as instructions an agent can follow.

resources.name: hero-prompt
resources.title: Hero Composition Prompt
resources.description: A targeted prompt for composing a page opening: it supplies the design system, the ratio, the resource set and the constraints, and asks for a plan before markup.

resources.name: audit-ui
resources.title: Audit UI Skill
resources.description: A skill for scoring an existing interface against the design rules and returning a structured report with scores, findings and ranked remediation steps.

resources.name: compose-page
resources.title: Compose Page Skill
resources.description: A skill that turns a page brief into a composition plan built from registry resources and a design system's DNA, with the ratio, sections and resource names made explicit before any code is written.

resources.name: blueprint-grid
resources.title: Blueprint Grid
resources.description: A modular grid drawn with repeating gradients, exposing the baseline and column rhythm of the page as a visible structure rather than an invisible assumption.

resources.name: grain-background
resources.title: Grain Background
resources.description: A film-grain surface generated from a single inline SVG turbulence filter, tuned by two custom properties, with a print-safe density and no image request.

resources.name: industrial-dashboard
resources.title: Industrial Dashboard
resources.description: An operations dashboard without cards: hairline-divided regions, monospace figures, a ledger table and a metric row that reads like instrumentation rather than marketing.

resources.name: accordion-index
resources.title: Accordion Index
resources.description: A numbered accordion built on native details/summary so it works without JavaScript, then enhanced with height animation and a hairline index rail.

resources.name: cn
resources.title: Class Name Merge
resources.description: The className helper every OpenUI resource uses: conditional classes with Tailwind conflict resolution, so consumers can always override styling.

resources.name: copy-button
resources.title: Copy Button
resources.description: Copy-to-clipboard with real failure handling: a visible state change, a polite screen-reader announcement, a legacy fallback and no false success.

resources.name: dock-navigation
resources.title: Dock Navigation
resources.description: A macOS-style navigation dock that magnifies icons by pointer distance with a falloff curve, magnification driven by one rAF-throttled pointermove and disabled on touch and reduced motion.

resources.name: ledger-table
resources.title: Ledger Table
resources.description: A dense data table built on real table semantics: hairline rules instead of card chrome, sortable columns with announced state, and sticky headers that stay legible.

resources.name: magnetic-button
resources.title: Magnetic Button
resources.description: A button whose label and edge follow the pointer inside a bounded magnet field. Keyboard, touch and reduced-motion behaviour stay identical to a plain button.

resources.name: marquee-index
resources.title: Marquee Index
resources.description: An infinite horizontal ticker that pauses for keyboard focus and hover, and renders static under prefers-reduced-motion instead of animating invisibly.

resources.name: segmented-control
resources.title: Segmented Control
resources.description: A segmented switcher with roving tabindex and arrow-key navigation, implemented as a real radiogroup rather than a row of buttons pretending to be one.

resources.name: smart-breadcrumb
resources.title: Smart Breadcrumb
resources.description: A breadcrumb that collapses its middle entries into a disclosure menu once the trail overflows, measured with a ResizeObserver so truncation adapts to the container rather than a fixed item count.

resources.name: status-pill
resources.title: Status Pill
resources.description: A compact status label with variants that carry meaning without relying on colour alone, using a leading glyph and an accessible label for screen readers.

resources.name: toast-region
resources.title: Toast Region
resources.description: An accessible notification region with a single provider, queued announcements, polite versus assertive politeness, and a fixed corner that never covers the interface.

resources.name: use-canvas-loop
resources.title: Use Canvas Loop
resources.description: The registry's shared canvas animation loop: DPR-correct sizing, pause when hidden or offscreen, a single static frame under reduced motion, and guaranteed teardown.

resources.name: use-in-view
resources.title: Use In View
resources.description: An IntersectionObserver hook with once-mode for lazy activation, automatic disconnect on unmount, and a pre-mount false so SSR and hydration agree.

resources.name: use-reduced-motion
resources.title: Use Reduced Motion
resources.description: A hook that subscribes to prefers-reduced-motion and reports whether the user asked for reduced motion, so resources can replace animation with state changes.

resources.name: industrial-archive
resources.title: Industrial Archive
resources.description: A dense archive system: monospace as the primary voice, cut corners instead of radii, mosaic composition, one amber signal, and instrumentation-density tables.

resources.name: swiss-editorial
resources.title: Swiss Editorial
resources.description: A persistent design system: asymmetric composition at a 7/5 ratio, a display serif against a neutral grotesk, sharp geometry, hairline structure and motion used only to explain hierarchy.

resources.name: cursor-trail
resources.title: Cursor Trail
resources.description: A pointer trail drawn with a fixed-size pool of divs and one animation frame loop, disabled on coarse pointers and under reduced motion, and paused when the tab is hidden.

resources.name: spotlight-follow
resources.title: Spotlight Follow
resources.description: A radial highlight that tracks the pointer using two CSS custom properties written once per frame, so the effect costs no layout or paint work beyond a composited layer.

resources.name: asymmetric-split
resources.title: Asymmetric Split
resources.description: A two-column shell with a deliberate ratio (7/5 by default), a gutter that becomes a visible rule, and a stack order that recomposes — rather than hides — content on small screens.

resources.name: breathing-loader
resources.title: Breathing Loader
resources.description: A loader that breathes instead of spins: concentric rings expand and contract on offset sine phases with opacity tied to the exhale — calm by design, with a minutes-elapsed counter for long operations.

resources.name: cloth-simulation-banner
resources.title: Cloth Simulation Banner
resources.description: A physics-based Verlet integration mesh simulating a woven fabric flag waving dynamically in response to wind velocity.

resources.name: confetti-blast-trigger
resources.title: Confetti Blast Trigger
resources.description: A celebratory burst of multi-colored vector fragments detonating outward on click with gravity falloff.

resources.name: count-up-spring
resources.title: Count Up Spring
resources.description: Numeric tween driven by a spring, not an easing curve: the displayed value overshoots the target and settles, digits use tabular numerals so widths never jitter, and re-targeting mid-flight re-targets the spring without restart.

resources.name: cursor-particle-fountain
resources.title: Cursor Particle Fountain
resources.description: A decorative canvas fountain erupting gravity-bound sparkles as pointer travels rapidly across the surface.

resources.name: cursor-trail-ribbon
resources.title: Cursor Trail Ribbon
resources.description: A fading ribbon that follows the pointer as a polyline of recent positions rendered on canvas with quadratic smoothing — width and opacity taper along the trail's age, decaying to nothing when the pointer stops.

resources.name: data-stream-rows
resources.title: Data Stream Rows
resources.description: Streaming rows enter at the top and push older rows down with a measured slide (FLIP), each new row flashing once on arrival — the motion of a live feed, honest about the fact that data keeps arriving.

resources.name: drag-snap-grid
resources.title: Drag Snap Grid
resources.description: Draggable tiles that snap to the nearest grid cell on release with a spring settle — occupancy is enforced (a cell holds one tile), and the displaced tile animates to the freed cell, making the grid itself the state machine.

resources.name: dynamic-island-morph
resources.title: Dynamic Island Morph
resources.description: A compact floating pill header that morphs smoothly into a wide notification panel upon incoming state event.

resources.name: elastic-accordion
resources.title: Elastic Accordion
resources.description: An accordion whose panels open with elastic overshoot: neighbouring rows are pushed with a spring-lag (each row's displacement chases the row above), so the stack wobbles like a slinky instead of snapping rigid.

resources.name: elastic-badge-pop
resources.title: Elastic Badge Pop
resources.description: An interactive notification badge pill that squashes and springs into existence with vibrant rubberband momentum.

resources.name: elastic-bottom-sheet
resources.title: Elastic Bottom Sheet
resources.description: A tactile mobile-style bottom sheet featuring drag resistance, velocity snap points, and rubberband bounds.

resources.name: elastic-drawer-curtain
resources.title: Elastic Drawer Curtain
resources.description: A lateral drawer with an elastic pull string that deforms under user drag before parting cleanly from the screen edge.

resources.name: elastic-fab-menu
resources.title: Elastic Fab Menu
resources.description: A floating action button erupting into a fan of child action buttons with spring overshoot upon toggle.

resources.name: elastic-orbit-loader
resources.title: Elastic Orbit Loader
resources.description: A celestial loading spinner featuring multi-satellite nodes orbiting an elliptical nucleus with gravitational acceleration at periapsis and spring-tethered lag.

resources.name: elastic-radio-pill
resources.title: Elastic Radio Pill
resources.description: A segmented radio pill whose active highlight stretches horizontally before snapping into place with spring momentum.

resources.name: elastic-split-reveal
resources.title: Elastic Split Reveal
resources.description: A split-screen curtain reveal dividing a surface along a central diagonal or horizontal axis with rubberband overshoot on trigger.

resources.name: elastic-stepper-dots
resources.title: Elastic Stepper Dots
resources.description: Pagination carousel dots where the active dot stretches into an elongated pill before snapping to the next target.

resources.name: elastic-tag-reorder
resources.title: Elastic Tag Reorder
resources.description: An interactive tag pill shelf where items exchange grid slots with smooth spring-driven layout shifts.

resources.name: exit-collapse-swap
resources.title: Exit Collapse Swap
resources.description: List-item removal done respectfully: the leaving item animates height, margin and opacity to zero while neighbours slide into place simultaneously via FLIP measurement — no layout jump, no re-render jank.

resources.name: exit-fade-hierarchy
resources.title: Exit Fade Hierarchy
resources.description: Content exits in reverse importance order: the least important elements fade first, headings hold longest — a choreography where the eye keeps its anchor while everything else dissolves around it.

resources.name: floating-dock-magnifier
resources.title: Floating Dock Magnifier
resources.description: A desktop navigation dock where individual icon targets scale smoothly using a Gaussian proximity curve as pointer glides across.

resources.name: fluid-drawer-peek
resources.title: Fluid Drawer Peek
resources.description: A bottom sheet drawer with tactile peek resting states, rubberband drag boundary resistance, and spring release velocity interpolation.

resources.name: fluid-segmented-meter
resources.title: Fluid Segmented Meter
resources.description: A multi-cell battery meter filling discrete energy blocks with sequenced neon charge pulses.

resources.name: fluid-tab-indicator
resources.title: Fluid Tab Indicator
resources.description: A segmented tab bar featuring a liquid underline that stretches and snaps between targets with non-linear spring physics.

resources.name: glitch-interrupt
resources.title: Glitch Interrupt
resources.description: Random micro-glitches interrupt an otherwise calm element: RGB-split flickers, 1-frame clip slices and character substitutions fire on a seeded schedule, then the element returns to perfect stillness — decay, not a loop.

resources.name: gravity-bounce-badge
resources.title: Gravity Bounce Badge
resources.description: A notification counter token dropping into screen space and settling via damped harmonic bouncing.

resources.name: gravity-well-card
resources.title: Gravity Well Card
resources.description: An interactive card where orbital canvas particles accelerate inward toward the pointer like miniature stellar matter.

resources.name: gyroscopic-card-tilt
resources.title: Gyroscopic Card Tilt
resources.description: A layered holographic identity card that tilts dynamically in 3D space based on mouse angle, simulating physical glass inertia.

resources.name: hover-swap-face
resources.title: Hover Swap Face
resources.description: A card with two registered faces that swap on hover via a 3D flip around the horizontal axis — not opacity crossfade but genuine rotation, with the resting face dimming slightly before the flip begins (anticipation).

resources.name: idle-float-loop
resources.title: Idle Float Loop
resources.description: Multi-element idle float where each child bobs on its own sine wave with independent amplitude, period and phase — a still-life that breathes, with the entire system pausing via one reduced-motion check.

resources.name: inertia-scroll-marquee
resources.title: Inertia Scroll Marquee
resources.description: A dual-strip ticker banner with interactive swipe flick: dragging alters translation velocity, settling back smoothly to baseline crawl velocity.

resources.name: inertial-rebound-scroll
resources.title: Inertial Rebound Scroll
resources.description: A scroll container featuring physical overscroll rubberbanding that snaps back to boundaries via damped spring physics.

resources.name: kinetic-accordion-stack
resources.title: Kinetic Accordion Stack
resources.description: A vertical accordion whose content height expands and contracts with smooth spring damping physics.

resources.name: kinetic-rubberband-toggle
resources.title: Kinetic Rubberband Toggle
resources.description: A switch control whose pill thumb elongates and squashes during travel, simulating high-elasticity rubber before snapping into rest shape.

resources.name: kinetic-slider-rail
resources.title: Kinetic Slider Rail
resources.description: A continuous range slider with elastic thumb drag that snaps into discrete calibrated detents upon release.

resources.name: kinetic-stepper-counter
resources.title: Kinetic Stepper Counter
resources.description: An animated counter displaying rolling numeric wheels with momentum acceleration and vertical wheel blur.

resources.name: kinetic-type-reveal
resources.title: Kinetic Type Reveal
resources.description: A mechanical typewriter entrance effect featuring physical carriage returns and vibrating strike-head impressions.

resources.name: liquid-card-expand
resources.title: Liquid Card Expand
resources.description: A card thumbnail that morphs dynamically into an expanded modal sheet with shared layout boundary transitions.

resources.name: liquid-shape-morph
resources.title: Liquid Shape Morph
resources.description: A surface that morphs between organic blob shapes using animated border-radius interpolation across eight values — the cheapest real morph in CSS, with asymmetric timing so the blob never looks mechanical.

resources.name: magnetic-anchor-tooltip
resources.title: Magnetic Anchor Tooltip
resources.description: A contextual tooltip balloon anchored via invisible elastic tether that leans smoothly toward pointer cursor.

resources.name: magnetic-button-cluster
resources.title: Magnetic Button Cluster
resources.description: An array of navigation pills that displace collectively toward cursor proximity with inverted spring tension.

resources.name: magnetic-card-hover
resources.title: Magnetic Card Hover
resources.description: An elevation card that lifts and casts dynamic cast shadows while floating softly toward cursor position.

resources.name: magnetic-cursor-follower
resources.title: Magnetic Cursor Follower
resources.description: A trailing fluid pointer node that elongates along its velocity vector when mouse moves fast.

resources.name: magnetic-cursor-halo
resources.title: Magnetic Cursor Halo
resources.description: An ethereal circular reticle that trails pointer coordinates with damped inertia and expands on interactive target hover.

resources.name: magnetic-dock
resources.title: Magnetic Dock
resources.description: A dock where icons gravitate toward the pointer within an influence field: displacement falls off with distance (inverse-square), neighbours lean toward the cursor, and the dock lifts as a whole when engaged.

resources.name: magnetic-pull-card
resources.title: Magnetic Pull Card
resources.description: A card surface that feels magnetic attraction toward the pointer with dual-stage translation and 3D rotational tilt governed by Hooke's law.

resources.name: magnetic-repel-field
resources.title: Magnetic Repel Field
resources.description: The anti-magnet: grid tiles flee the pointer with force proportional to proximity, then spring back with damped oscillation — a field of objects that keeps its shape only when you leave it alone.

resources.name: magnetic-switch-slider
resources.title: Magnetic Switch Slider
resources.description: An industrial toggle lever sliding smoothly along a linear track with metallic snap detents and spring vibration.

resources.name: momentum-flick-card
resources.title: Momentum Flick Card
resources.description: A card deck element that responds to pointer swipe velocity, flying away when flicked beyond velocity threshold or springing back to center.

resources.name: momentum-panel
resources.title: Momentum Panel
resources.description: A draggable panel that keeps its release velocity: throw it and it coasts with friction, bounces off container edges with restitution, and comes to rest where physics puts it — gesture + inertia in one primitive.

resources.name: morph-search-bar
resources.title: Morph Search Bar
resources.description: A compact search icon button that expands smoothly into a full input field upon user click.

resources.name: morphing-hamburger
resources.title: Morphing Hamburger
resources.description: The three-bar icon that becomes an X through genuine morphing: bars are separate elements whose rotations and translations interpolate through a shared keyframe timeline, so the middle bar thins and fades while the outer bars cross precisely.

resources.name: orbit-ring-spinner
resources.title: Orbit Ring Spinner
resources.description: A gyroscopic multi-axis ring loading spinner executing concentric orbital rotations with varying phase velocities.

resources.name: orbit-satellite-badge
resources.title: Orbit Satellite Badge
resources.description: A small circular notification satellite executing continuous Keplerian orbit around an icon container.

resources.name: orbital-revolution
resources.title: Orbital Revolution
resources.description: Satellites revolve a centre point on elliptical paths with independent periods and phases; each body's opacity and scale respond to depth (behind/in front of the centre), faking 3D with pure transforms.

resources.name: page-diagonal-wipe
resources.title: Page Diagonal Wipe
resources.description: A 45-degree angled clip-path diagonal wipe sweeping across the screen boundary on section change.

resources.name: page-shutter-transition
resources.title: Page Shutter Transition
resources.description: An aperture shutter transition consisting of interleaved horizontal blinds wiping the viewport between states.

resources.name: page-wipe-transition
resources.title: Page Wipe Transition
resources.description: A full-bleed panel wipes across the viewport in two phases — an entering panel covers with an accelerated ease, the new content is swapped beneath it, then the panel exits slower with deceleration, mimicking an editor's cut.

resources.name: parallax-depth-cards
resources.title: Parallax Depth Cards
resources.description: A trio of floating cards translating at differential Z-depth velocities as the user interacts with the container.

resources.name: parallax-layer-stack
resources.title: Parallax Layer Stack
resources.description: Depth from scroll: three planes move at different rates (background 0.3×, mid 0.6×, foreground 1.2×) with depths declared per layer, plus a gentle scale falloff so far planes feel genuinely distant.

resources.name: perspective-carousel
resources.title: Perspective Carousel
resources.description: A 3D revolving cylindrical carousel rotating items across an elliptical perspective plane on click.

resources.name: perspective-cube-flip
resources.title: Perspective Cube Flip
resources.description: A 3D cube revolving 90 degrees around its horizontal axis to transition between dual interactive facets.

resources.name: perspective-plane-reveal
resources.title: Perspective Plane Reveal
resources.description: Content reveals as a plane rotating up from the floor of its own perspective container — rotateX from -75° with transform-origin at the bottom edge, so the element rises like a drawbridge instead of sliding.

resources.name: physics-pendulum-dial
resources.title: Physics Pendulum Dial
resources.description: An angular balance indicator suspended from a top pivot that swings with gravitational restoring torque and damped oscillations when pulled.

resources.name: physics-rope-pulley
resources.title: Physics Rope Pulley
resources.description: Two masses connected over a frictionless circular pulley simulating Newtonian gravity exchange when one is dragged.

resources.name: pulse-ring-beacon
resources.title: Pulse Ring Beacon
resources.description: An animated radar status indicator broadcasting expanding concentric pulse rings into surrounding space.

resources.name: radial-progress-wheel
resources.title: Radial Progress Wheel
resources.description: An SVG circular progress ring animating through arc strokes with continuous dash-offset rotation and elastic endpoint spring.

resources.name: rebound-checkbox
resources.title: Rebound Checkbox
resources.description: A mechanical checkbox whose border compresses elastically before springing an animated SVG checkmark into lock.

resources.name: ripple-touch-field
resources.title: Ripple Touch Field
resources.description: A tactile responsive canvas emitting expanding concentric shockwave rings on click with physics decay.

resources.name: rubber-slider-knob
resources.title: Rubber Slider Knob
resources.description: A rotary dial knob providing tactile angular drag resistance that rebounds smoothly when released past threshold.

resources.name: scroll-compression
resources.title: Scroll Compression
resources.description: A stack of panels that compresses together as the page scrolls — each layer's gap interpolates from loose to sealed based on scroll progress through the section, like a deck being squeezed shut.

resources.name: scroll-curtain-reveal
resources.title: Scroll Curtain Reveal
resources.description: A dual-leaf curtain mechanism that parts horizontally across the viewport as the user scrolls, unveiling underlying content.

resources.name: scroll-lens-magnifier
resources.title: Scroll Lens Magnifier
resources.description: A circular magnifying viewport that glides over underlying text during scroll, scaling the focus area dynamically.

resources.name: scroll-progress-ring
resources.title: Scroll Progress Ring
resources.description: Reading progress drawn as an SVG ring around a fixed badge: the stroke fills clockwise with scroll progress, the percentage ticks in tabular numerals in the centre, and clicking it scrolls back to top.

resources.name: scroll-reveal
resources.title: Scroll Reveal
resources.description: IntersectionObserver reveal with staggered children, one observer per instance, unobserve-on-reveal, and a reduced-motion path that shows content immediately.

resources.name: scroll-skew-sections
resources.title: Scroll Skew Sections
resources.description: Alternating sections skew in opposing directions with scroll velocity — even sections lean forward, odd sections lean back, creating a shear wave through the page that flattens when scrolling stops.

resources.name: scroll-velocity-blur-hero
resources.title: Scroll Velocity Blur Hero
resources.description: A hero whose letters gain directional blur proportional to scroll speed and settle crisp at rest — using a stacked text-shadow trick instead of filter blur so it stays GPU-cheap even on long pages.

resources.name: shared-layout-morph
resources.title: Shared Layout Morph
resources.description: A selected card expands into a detail panel while its identity persists: FLIP technique — first, last, invert, play — implemented from scratch with measured rects and one transform, so the element never teleports.

resources.name: shimmer-skeleton-loader
resources.title: Shimmer Skeleton Loader
resources.description: An ethereal wireframe content placeholder swept continuously by an angled light sheen gradient during loading.

resources.name: soundwave-visualizer-bar
resources.title: Soundwave Visualizer Bar
resources.description: An audio equalizer bar array pulsating with organic harmonic frequency fluctuations and vertical dancing springs.

resources.name: split-flap-solari-board
resources.title: Split Flap Solari Board
resources.description: An airport departure style Solari split-flap mechanical display cascading through alphabet characters with realistic flap clicks.

resources.name: spring-card-stack-swipe
resources.title: Spring Card Stack Swipe
resources.description: A deck of cards that can be dismissed left or right with velocity swipe detection and spring restitution.

resources.name: spring-drawer
resources.title: Spring Drawer
resources.description: A drawer that follows the finger 1:1 during drag and uses a velocity-aware spring on release: fast flicks complete the gesture even past the halfway mark, slow drags need majority travel — gesture semantics done properly.

resources.name: spring-drop-in
resources.title: Spring Drop In
resources.description: Entrance motion built on a critically damped spring equation run in rAF: element falls from above with velocity-carrying overshoot, one bounce below rest position, then settles — parameterised by stiffness and damping, not keyframes.

resources.name: spring-snapping-slider
resources.title: Spring Snapping Slider
resources.description: A numeric range control where the thumb glides with simulated mass and snaps toward discrete notched positions via magnetic spring detents.

resources.name: spring-toast-stack
resources.title: Spring Toast Stack
resources.description: A cascade of alert cards stacked behind one another that eject smoothly when dismissed using hookean spring dynamics.

resources.name: stagger-cascade
resources.title: Stagger Cascade
resources.description: Child elements enter in sequence where each successive delay is computed from the previous child's actual animation end (not a fixed step) — cascades that stay correct even when children have different durations.

resources.name: staggered-avatar-fan
resources.title: Staggered Avatar Fan
resources.description: A compact deck of overlapping user avatars that fans out radially on hover with proportional rotational offsets.

resources.name: staggered-bar-chart
resources.title: Staggered Bar Chart
resources.description: An animated analytics histogram whose vertical bars rise sequentially with staggered elastic spring overshoot on trigger.

resources.name: staggered-glyph-cascade
resources.title: Staggered Glyph Cascade
resources.description: A dramatic entrance reveal splitting strings into glyphs that drop down like raindrops with slight pseudo-random angle jitter and spring settle.

resources.name: staggered-list-fade
resources.title: Staggered List Fade
resources.description: A cascade of record items fading and sliding sequentially into position upon trigger with incremental delays.

resources.name: staggered-metric-counter
resources.title: Staggered Metric Counter
resources.description: A KPI scorecard row where numeric metrics increment simultaneously with staggered duration and spring finish.

resources.name: sticky-stack
resources.title: Sticky Stack
resources.description: Cards that pin and stack as the page scrolls, driven entirely by CSS position sticky so there is no scroll listener, no jank and no JavaScript.

resources.name: sway-tree-navigation
resources.title: Sway Tree Navigation
resources.description: A nested folder hierarchy where tree branches sway organically with delayed momentum when expanded or hovered.

resources.name: tilt-spring-card
resources.title: Tilt Spring Card
resources.description: Pointer-driven 3D tilt with a real spring integrator: rotation chases the pointer through a damped spring rather than lerping, so quick circles overshoot and settle — the difference between a transition and a physical object.

resources.name: velocity-fade-list
resources.title: Velocity Fade List
resources.description: List items whose opacity and vertical blur respond to scroll velocity — scrolling fast dissolves the rows into streaks, slowing down brings them back into focus — motion feedback that measures impatience.

resources.name: wave-handoff
resources.title: Wave Handoff
resources.description: Two rows of content hand off motion to each other: as the top row settles, its last element's exit velocity is inherited by the first element of the next row — energy conservation applied to entrance choreography.

resources.name: wave-progress-bar
resources.title: Wave Progress Bar
resources.description: A fluid meter simulating dynamic liquid surging across a container as its percentage fill level rises.

resources.name: wave-text-reveal
resources.title: Wave Text Reveal
resources.description: A headline phrase whose characters oscillate in an undulated sine wave rhythm before locking into typography baseline.

resources.name: asymmetric-hero
resources.title: Asymmetric Hero
resources.description: An opening section with a 5/7 vertical split, an edge-to-edge index rail and a display heading that is composed from type rather than a gradient block.

resources.name: editorial-navigation
resources.title: Editorial Navigation
resources.description: A two-tier masthead: a thin utility strip above a ruled wordmark row, with a mobile disclosure that keeps the same reading order and no hamburger icon dependency.

resources.name: acrostic-column
resources.title: Acrostic Column
resources.description: A poem whose initial letters spell a hidden word down the left edge: the initials column is emphasised, hovering it lights the full acrostic, and a reveal toggle confirms the message — a medieval device implemented as a responsive layout.

resources.name: balance-subhead
resources.title: Balance Subhead
resources.description: A subhead that uses text-wrap: balance with a JS fallback that greedily evens line lengths for older engines — ragged edges tamed typographically, with a live before/after toggle for teaching the difference.

resources.name: baseline-grid-overlay
resources.title: Baseline Grid Overlay
resources.description: A proofing tool that overlays the document's baseline grid on any block of text and flags lines that drift off it — vertical rhythm made visible, with a drift count readout for CI-style typographic QA.

resources.name: baseline-slide-lines
resources.title: Baseline Slide Lines
resources.description: Multi-line reveal where each line is its own clipped rail and slides up from below the baseline with per-line delay; line breaks are authored, so the composition survives font substitution.

resources.name: bidi-mirror-type
resources.title: Bidi Mirror Type
resources.description: A dual-direction type specimen: the same phrase rendered LTR and RTL simultaneously, with per-glyph mirroring toggle and automatic dir attribute handling — a working tool for checking internationalised typography.

resources.name: bionic-emphasis-text
resources.title: Bionic Emphasis Text
resources.description: Reading-aid typography that bolds the leading fragment of every word at a set attention ratio, guiding the eye through long paragraphs without changing a single word — a genuine legibility system, not decoration.

resources.name: blind-deboss-toggle
resources.title: Blind Deboss Toggle
resources.description: A tactile switch rendered as typography: the word ON or OFF sits in a soft rubber pad and physically debosses on press — shadows invert, the glyph sinks — a state indicator you can feel with your eyes.

resources.name: blur-reveal-text
resources.title: Blur Reveal Text
resources.description: A focus-pull reveal: words start defocused and transparent, then sharpen in reading order with an interleaved delay, using only filter and opacity so layout is stable throughout.

resources.name: braille-dual-render
resources.title: Braille Dual Render
resources.description: Renders a phrase in both Latin type and Unicode braille side by side, with per-cell dot animation on value change and real screen-reader behaviour (Latin spoken, braille aria-hidden decoration).

resources.name: census-bar-heading
resources.title: Census Bar Heading
resources.description: A headline where each word carries a data bar underneath whose width encodes a value — typography and chart fused into one element, so a sentence can literally show its own distribution.

resources.name: chapter-numeral-roman
resources.title: Chapter Numeral Roman
resources.description: Chapter openers with an oversized roman numeral set behind the title as a ghost layer — the numeral clips through the heading on scroll using a background-attached gradient, so text passes over it like a watermark.

resources.name: character-wheel-picker
resources.title: Character Wheel Picker
resources.description: A slot-machine you drive: up/down arrows (or wheel) spin each character column independently through the alphabet with inertial easing, composing text letter by letter — an input mechanism, not an animation.

resources.name: chisel-carve-type
resources.title: Chisel Carve Type
resources.description: Letters carved into stone: dark text with a top inner highlight and bottom occlusion shadow inverted from the emboss formula, sitting on a speckled granite background built from layered radial gradients.

resources.name: chord-lyric-sheet
resources.title: Chord Lyric Sheet
resources.description: Song sheet typography: chord names float above lyrics in a monospace grid with exact column alignment, chord lines tint, and tapping a chord plays nothing but shows its fingering in a popover — alignment typography as musical notation.

resources.name: circular-type
resources.title: Circular Type
resources.description: Text set on an SVG circular path that rotates continuously while the centre stays readable — a seal or stamp composition, with circumference-matched font sizing so the ring always closes cleanly.

resources.name: code-token-typeset
resources.title: Code Token Typeset
resources.description: Inline code typeset as a first-class citizen: a tiny tokenizer (keywords, strings, comments, numbers) renders spans with typographic detail most highlighters skip — tabular numerals, zero-width joiners and per-token kerning fixes.

resources.name: counter-typography
resources.title: Counter Typography
resources.description: Numeric tweening with tabular figures, an ease-out curve and locale-aware grouping; the width is reserved from the final value so the surrounding line never shifts while counting.

resources.name: decrypt-text
resources.title: Decrypt Text
resources.description: Click-to-decrypt ciphertext: a button-styled text surface that re-runs a keyed glyph resolution on every activation, with run progress announced to screen readers and deterministic per-index glyphs.

resources.name: dictionary-headword
resources.title: Dictionary Headword
resources.description: A full dictionary entry layout: headword with syllable breaks, IPA pronunciation, part-of-speech italics, numbered senses with semicolon-separated examples, and etymology in a hanging indent — all semantic definition-list markup.

resources.name: editorial-drop-cap
resources.title: Editorial Drop Cap
resources.description: A true initial letter: the first character sits in a measured float spanning a fixed number of text lines, with a hanging indent recomputed from the glyph's actual advance width, not a guessed ch value.

resources.name: editorial-heading
resources.title: Editorial Heading
resources.description: A display heading that splits into a lead phrase and an emphasised phrase, with an optional italic contrast, hairline rule and index label. The type does the composing, not a gradient.

resources.name: elastic-stretch-text
resources.title: Elastic Stretch Text
resources.description: Glyphs stretch horizontally away from the pointer like a material with tension, using scaleX with an overshoot curve on release; the stretch is per-glyph so the word deforms, not just moves.

resources.name: emboss-paint-type
resources.title: Emboss Paint Type
resources.description: Letterpress typography built from four stacked text-shadow layers on a single element — no images, no SVG — with the layer offsets derived from one custom property so the depth is themeable.

resources.name: firework-pop-glyphs
resources.title: Firework Pop Glyphs
resources.description: Celebration typography: on trigger, each glyph fires once — pops upward with rotation, bursts into two spark pseudo-elements that fly apart, then the glyph re-seats with an overshoot settle. One shot per click.

resources.name: flip-clock-digits
resources.title: Flip Clock Digits
resources.description: Split-flap style digit transitions: each changing digit folds through a two-panel rotateX with a shadow phase, built on real 3D transforms with backface culling and per-digit stagger.

resources.name: foundry-specimen-sheet
resources.title: Foundry Specimen Sheet
resources.description: A variable-font specimen: one phrase rendered at descending sizes and weights in a strict table, with a live weight axis slider that re-renders every row — how type foundries actually present a cut.

resources.name: fountain-pen-signature
resources.title: Fountain Pen Signature
resources.description: A cursive signature drawn as an SVG stroke path with variable stroke width (two overlapping paths slightly offset), animating via dashoffset as if written by hand — sign here, then wipe and re-sign.

resources.name: gerund-loading-label
resources.title: Gerund Loading Label
resources.description: Loading states as real gerunds: “Validating…”, “Compiling…”, “Installing…” — the label swaps at random-ish intervals with a typing underline that grows like a progress sense, and a final past-tense completion flip.

resources.name: glitch-type
resources.title: Glitch Type
resources.description: Burst-based glitching, not a permanent loop: on an interval the text fires a 3-frame RGB channel split with clip-path slicing, then rests clean — the disturbance reads as an event, not wallpaper.

resources.name: glyph-flock-text
resources.title: Glyph Flock Text
resources.description: Letters behave as boids: each glyph steers away from the pointer within its influence radius and eases back to its baseline slot when the pointer leaves, giving the headline a startled-school-of-fish quality.

resources.name: gradient-outline-type
resources.title: Gradient Outline Type
resources.description: Display text rendered as a gradient stroke with a transparent fill, layered twice — a wide soft pass under a crisp narrow pass — so the outline reads as an object rather than a filter.

resources.name: gravity-letters
resources.title: Gravity Letters
resources.description: Click the headline and each letter drops off its baseline with individual delay and bounce easing, then reassembles on the next click — a deterministic physics sketch using transitions, not an engine.

resources.name: hatch-fill-type
resources.title: Hatch Fill Type
resources.description: Glyphs filled with diagonal hatching instead of ink: a repeating-linear-gradient clipped to the text, with hatch angle, spacing and weight exposed as controls — engraved-plate shading as a fill system.

resources.name: hover-replace-text
resources.title: Hover Replace Text
resources.description: Two stacked labels that cross-fade and slide on hover with a directional bias from the pointer's entry side; tap toggles on touch, and keyboard focus triggers the same swap.

resources.name: idle-fade-whisper
resources.title: Idle Fade Whisper
resources.description: Ambient text that slowly fades toward invisibility while the reader is idle and breathes back on any input — presence-aware typography that rewards attention instead of demanding it.

resources.name: ink-underline-draw
resources.title: Ink Underline Draw
resources.description: Link underline drawn like a felt-tip stroke: an SVG path whose stroke-dashoffset animates left-to-right with a hand-drawn wobble, thicker in the middle, retraced in reverse when the pointer leaves.

resources.name: inline-diff-markup
resources.title: Inline Diff Markup
resources.description: Renders edits the way copyeditors mark them: insertions underlined in green, deletions struck in red — computed from a real word-level LCS diff, not hand-authored spans, so any two strings can be compared.

resources.name: inline-swap-sentence
resources.title: Inline Swap Sentence
resources.description: A sentence with one clickable word that cycles through alternatives on click — a live copy-testing widget where the sentence grammar stays intact and the swapped word rolls in with a vertical slide.

resources.name: jitter-type
resources.title: Jitter Type
resources.description: Seeded per-glyph jitter on a coarse grid: each character offsets by a quantised random amount that re-rolls on an offbeat interval, so the field feels alive without a full-time animation loop.

resources.name: justify-hyphen-proof
resources.title: Justify Hyphen Proof
resources.description: A justified paragraph with manual soft-hyphen control and rivers visualisation: toggle justification, hyphenation and a river-detector overlay that highlights the vertical gaps justified text leaves behind.

resources.name: karaoke-read-along
resources.title: Karaoke Read-Along
resources.description: A paragraph that highlights each chunk in sync with a timer while an aria-live region reads the current chunk — designed for language learning and read-along accessibility, with speed control and pause.

resources.name: kicker-overline-pair
resources.title: Kicker Overline Pair
resources.description: The magazine pairing: a tracked-out uppercase kicker over a display headline, locked to a shared baseline grid with an optically-weighted rule between them — one component that enforces the editorial relationship.

resources.name: kinetic-marquee
resources.title: Kinetic Marquee
resources.description: A continuous text band whose speed responds to scroll velocity — faster scrolling accelerates the ticker and skews it proportionally, settling back to base speed when scrolling stops.

resources.name: kinetic-ticker
resources.title: Kinetic Ticker
resources.description: A rotating word ticker that reserves the width of its longest phrase so the surrounding layout never reflows, and pauses when the tab is hidden.

resources.name: led-dot-matrix-text
resources.title: LED Dot Matrix Text
resources.description: Real dot-matrix rendering: a 5×7 bitmap font map draws each character as a grid of glowing dots on canvas — with per-dot bokeh, row scanlines and a scrolling mode that shifts the bitmap like a station display.

resources.name: lens-magnify-text
resources.title: Lens Magnify Text
resources.description: A circular lens that magnifies the text beneath it using a duplicated, scaled copy clipped to a circle that tracks the pointer — a magnifier, not a highlight, with true enlargement of glyph detail.

resources.name: letter-slot-machine
resources.title: Letter Slot Machine
resources.description: Each letter is a clipped vertical reel of the full alphabet; changing the value spins every reel through a different number of stops, so the word resolves left-to-right like a payline landing.

resources.name: letterpress-card-flip
resources.title: Letterpress Card Flip
resources.description: A business card with letterpress-printed type that flips in 3D on click to reveal contact details on the reverse — two independent letterpress faces, real transform-style 3D, and keyboard focus parity.

resources.name: liquid-merge-heading
resources.title: Liquid Merge Heading
resources.description: Two words drift toward each other on a loop, blur at the seam, and merge into one with a gooey SVG filter — then pull apart again. The metaball effect is a filter chain, not a physics engine.

resources.name: margin-note-annotations
resources.title: Margin Note Annotations
resources.description: Body text with superscript markers that open notes in the outer margin on wide viewports and inline expanders on narrow ones — a responsive recomposition of the scholarly annotation, not just a hidden block.

resources.name: measuring-tape-hover
resources.title: Measuring Tape Hover
resources.description: Hover any word and a measuring tape slides out beneath it showing its rendered width in px and ch — a debugging instrument for kerning obsessives, implemented with real getBoundingClientRect measurement per word.

resources.name: millimetre-ruler-scale
resources.title: Millimetre Ruler Scale
resources.description: A physical ruler rendered in CSS: millimetre ticks every 4px, centimetre ticks taller with numerals, edge-accurate against the page — hold a credit card against it in the demo to check your screen's true DPI.

resources.name: mirror-input-text
resources.title: Mirror Input Text
resources.description: A display line that mirrors whatever the user types into a real input, character-aligned and caret-synced — the foundation for terminal UIs, live captions and autofill previews, built as one composable primitive.

resources.name: mirror-reflect-text
resources.title: Mirror Reflect Text
resources.description: A vertical mirror of the headline rendered with a scaleY(-1) copy, masked by a gradient so the reflection fades with distance — positioned from the glyph baseline, not the box, so descenders sit right.

resources.name: neon-flicker-sign
resources.title: Neon Flicker Sign
resources.description: A neon sign built from text-shadow stacks with a scripted flicker that buzzes specific letters off-beat — the failure pattern of real signage, applied per glyph, resting steady most of the time.

resources.name: outline-fill-hover
resources.title: Outline Fill Hover
resources.description: Text drawn as a stroke that fills from the reading direction on hover — two stacked copies, the fill one clipped by a width transition, so the fill sweeps like ink soaking into a letter rather than fading in.

resources.name: overprint-misregister
resources.title: Overprint Misregister
resources.description: Simulated CMYK misregistration: cyan, magenta and yellow copies of the word sit one pixel off each side of a black key plate, and dragging a control shifts the plates further out of register like a cheap print run.

resources.name: password-strength-mark
resources.title: Password Strength Mark
resources.description: A wordmark that grades itself: the word STRENGTH renders letter-by-letter, and how many letters are inked versus ghosted encodes password score — typography doubling as a meter without a single bar.

resources.name: perspective-tilt-text
resources.title: Perspective Tilt Text
resources.description: Display text on a plane that tilts toward the pointer with rotateX/rotateY, layered with a translateZ shadow copy so the depth reads as physical; the transform origin eases back to centre on leave.

resources.name: pull-quote-rule
resources.title: Pull Quote Rule
resources.description: An oversized pull quote with a graduated emphasis trick: the first clause renders at full weight and the remainder tapers through two lighter tones — drawing the eye through the sentence in reading order.

resources.name: ransom-collage-note
resources.title: Ransom Collage Note
resources.description: Each glyph is clipped from its own 'scrap' — deterministic per-index rotation, paper tone, serif/sans alternation and tape strip — so the collage is chaotic to the eye but reproducible to the pixel across renders.

resources.name: reading-level-tinter
resources.title: Reading Level Tinter
resources.description: Each sentence is tinted by its own complexity — average word length and clause count map to an ink density ramp — so a paragraph shows you where it gets hard to read before you get there.

resources.name: redaction-declassifier
resources.title: Redaction Declassifier
resources.description: Government-memo typography: passages are blacked out with marker bars, and hovering (or focusing) a bar sweeps the ink away to reveal the text underneath, then re-redacts when attention leaves.

resources.name: reply-tree-thread
resources.title: Reply Tree Thread
resources.description: Discussion text structured as a tree: replies indent along ruled connector lines that draw in on expand, collapsed branches show reply counts, and the whole thread is keyboard-navigable with arrow keys.

resources.name: rsvp-speed-reader
resources.title: RSVP Speed Reader
resources.description: Rapid Serial Visual Presentation: words flash one at a time at a fixed focal point with the optimal recognition letter (ORP) highlighted in red, play/pause and WPM control — reading 400 wpm without moving your eyes.

resources.name: scatter-rain-text
resources.title: Scatter Rain Text
resources.description: On in-view, glyphs fall from above with per-letter delay, rotation and a tiny bounce, then stay put — a controlled storm where each drop lands on its own baseline slot, spring-free and transition-only.

resources.name: scramble-text
resources.title: Scramble Text
resources.description: Text that resolves from character noise to its final content, cycling each position through a glyph pool at its own rate so the reveal sweeps left to right rather than popping.

resources.name: scroll-lit-paragraph
resources.title: Scroll Lit Paragraph
resources.description: A long paragraph where words illuminate one by one as scroll progress passes them — reading position made spatial, like a cursor of light sweeping through the copy as the page moves.

resources.name: scroll-mask-wipe
resources.title: Scroll Mask Wipe
resources.description: A headline wiped open by the page's own scroll position: an inset clip-path tied to viewport progress means the reader, not a timer, controls how much of the statement is visible.

resources.name: scroll-shear-type
resources.title: Scroll Shear Type
resources.description: Headline that skews proportionally to scroll velocity and springs back to true when scrolling stops — the letters lean into the motion like pages fanned by wind, driven by a critically damped spring.

resources.name: sentiment-color-words
resources.title: Sentiment Color Words
resources.description: A sentiment readout where each word is tinted by its valence score on a diverging scale — negative cools, positive warms — with a hover tooltip exposing the exact score and a legend that doubles as the scale.

resources.name: sight-size-ruler
resources.title: Sight Size Ruler
resources.description: Specimen typography wrapped in a working ruler: cap-height, x-height and baseline rules are drawn to scale behind the glyphs, and hovering a rule calls out its name — type anatomy as an interactive diagram.

resources.name: silver-screen-subtitles
resources.title: Silver Screen Subtitles
resources.description: Cinema-grade subtitles: word-wrapped to 42 characters per line (the industry standard), timed against a playhead, positioned bottom-centre with a safety margin, and re-rendered per cue without animation jank.

resources.name: spectral-split-text
resources.title: Spectral Split Text
resources.description: Two chromatic copies of the headline offset in opposing directions with screen/ multiply blend modes, producing a prism-split edge that intensifies as the offset grows — chromatic aberration as a dial.

resources.name: spiral-arc-type
resources.title: Spiral Arc Type
resources.description: Text laid along an Archimedean spiral via per-glyph placement (rotate + translate per character), coiling from the outside in — glyphs shrink slightly with radius so the coil reads as one continuous word.

resources.name: split-flap-board
resources.title: Split Flap Board
resources.description: An airport-style flap display where each cell flips through cards top-over-bottom to reach its target; half-flap seams, staggered columns and the characteristic clack pacing are all CSS-only per cell.

resources.name: split-text
resources.title: Split Text
resources.description: Per-word reveal that keeps the sentence readable: words are wrapped in inline-block spans, the text stays selectable and copyable, and reduced motion shows the finished state immediately.

resources.name: spotlight-knockout
resources.title: Spotlight Knockout
resources.description: A wall of dark type with a spotlight hole punched through it: the headline sits underneath and is only legible inside a radial mask that tracks the pointer — reading becomes a searchlight act.

resources.name: stroke-draw-text
resources.title: Stroke Draw Text
resources.description: An SVG path rendition of the headline whose strokes draw themselves via stroke-dashoffset on entering view; the DOM text stays present for accessibility while the drawn paths carry the visual.

resources.name: swatch-words
resources.title: Swatch Words
resources.description: Colour names rendered in their own colour with a click-to-copy chip: the word is the swatch, a miniature circular chip rides the baseline, and clicking copies the hex with a small toast — a palette you can read.

resources.name: tabular-mass-edit
resources.title: Tabular Mass Edit
resources.description: A numeric column you can edit like a spreadsheet: tabular-numeral alignment, arrow-key cell navigation, per-cell validation that shakes invalid entries, and an aggregate footer that recomputes live.

resources.name: tally-glyph-counter
resources.title: Tally Glyph Counter
resources.description: Counts rendered as tally marks: groups of four vertical strokes with a diagonal fifth strike-through, animated stroke-by-stroke as the value ticks up — a counting display that predates numerals and still reads instantly.

resources.name: tf-auto-emphasis
resources.title: TF Auto Emphasis
resources.description: Automatic emphasis by term frequency: words repeated in the passage get progressively bolder, so the vocabulary that carries the text rises to the surface — a document outline you can see inside a paragraph.

resources.name: theatre-marquee-bulbs
resources.title: Theatre Marquee Bulbs
resources.description: A theatre sign where the border is a string of chasing light bulbs (CSS radial dots animating in sequence) around the lettering — the chase runs the perimeter while the text stays still, unlike every other marquee.

resources.name: thermal-print-type
resources.title: Thermal Print Type
resources.description: Text emerges as if printed by a receipt printer: a hard clip line sweeps downward in steps while a dither mask fades in behind it, with the characteristic slight horizontal jitter of a misaligned head.

resources.name: thermal-receipt-total
resources.title: Thermal Receipt Total
resources.description: A receipt layout with dot-leader lines between item names and prices, a dashed separator, a double-ruled total, and tabular numerals that keep every currency column aligned — the typography of honest arithmetic.

resources.name: ticker-tape-deltas
resources.title: Ticker Tape Deltas
resources.description: A stock-quote tape: symbols scroll horizontally while up/down deltas render as triangle glyphs with tabular numerals, ticking live values and flashing the cell background on change like a trading terminal.

resources.name: time-of-day-greeting
resources.title: Time of Day Greeting
resources.description: A greeting that recomposes by clock: morning/afternoon/evening/night word, a gradient sky bar reflecting the hour, and a live minute hand of text — the heading itself is the clock, no icons involved.

resources.name: tracked-changes-accept
resources.title: Tracked Changes Accept
resources.description: A paragraph with tracked insertions and deletions (like a legal review) plus per-change Accept/Reject controls — accepting morphs the text in place with a colour fade, rejecting strikes it out permanently.

resources.name: type-stack
resources.title: Type Stack
resources.description: A vertical stack of phrases that cycles with a directional slide, reserving the height of the longest phrase so surrounding layout never reflows; pauses on hover and focus.

resources.name: typewriter-stack
resources.title: Typewriter Stack
resources.description: Types and deletes successive phrases with a blinking caret, where typing speed varies per character (humanised), deletion is faster than typing, and the caret width adapts to the current glyph.

resources.name: variable-weight-text
resources.title: Variable Weight Text
resources.description: Per-glyph font-variation weight driven by distance to the pointer, so the word swells under the cursor like a pressure field; falls back to a static mid weight without a pointer.

resources.name: verse-line-numbers
resources.title: Verse Line Numbers
resources.description: Poetry typesetting with margin line numbers every fifth line plus an active-line follower that brightens the number of the line currently in the viewport centre — scripture-style apparatus, live.

resources.name: vertical-kern-text
resources.title: Vertical Kern Text
resources.description: A label set in vertical writing mode with upright Latin glyphs and controlled letter spacing, for spines, rails and side navigation where horizontal space is the constraint.

resources.name: vertical-phrase-ticker
resources.title: Vertical Phrase Ticker
resources.description: A fixed-height window where phrases slide vertically through like a stock ticker — the outgoing line exits upward while the incoming one enters from below simultaneously, keeping the box a constant height.

resources.name: wandering-gradient-type
resources.title: Wandering Gradient Type
resources.description: A multi-stop gradient that drifts through the glyphs on a slow non-repeating noise path — background-position animated through keyframes that never land on the same offset twice in a row, so the colour never loops visibly.

resources.name: wave-text
resources.title: Wave Text
resources.description: Each glyph rides a sine wave with a phase offset from its position, producing a travelling swell through the word; implemented with per-character spans and a shared animation-delay variable.

resources.name: wax-seal-stamp
resources.title: Wax Seal Stamp
resources.description: An initials monogram pressed into a wax disc: radial-gradient wax with irregular blob edge (border-radius trick), debossed lettering via inner shadows, and a press animation on click that re-stamps the seal.

resources.name: whisper-stage-direction
resources.title: Whisper Stage Direction
resources.description: Play-script typography where italic stage directions sit inset from the speech, character names are tracked caps on their own line, and clicking a direction highlights the affected character's next line — theatre markup made navigable.

resources.name: word-help-balloons
resources.title: Word Help Balloons
resources.description: Dotted-underline terms that open small paper balloons on focus or hover with a definition, arrow and all — real popover semantics (button + role), not a CSS-only mirage, so keyboard users get the same affordance.

resources.name: editorial-oxide
resources.title: Editorial Oxide
resources.description: A warm editorial theme: book paper, iron-gall ink, oxide accent, a display serif for statements and a mono face for metadata.

resources.name: industrial-mono
resources.title: Industrial Mono
resources.description: A dark instrumentation theme: near-black grounds, phosphor text, monospace as the primary voice, and one amber signal reserved for attention.

resources.name: swiss-ledger
resources.title: Swiss Ledger
resources.description: A high-contrast Swiss theme: warm paper, true ink, one signal red, zero radius, hairline rules and a type scale built for tabular comparison.
